As documented in /app/research_evidence.json, reject transplanting historical scene-specific door transforms as a general repair and reject treating equal heights, node count or AABB overlap as proof of contact or material improvement.
changes: Added explicit limits on synthetic validation to /app/library/SKILL.md; no executable unit was modified.
Preserved probe script, editable blend and Blender logs outside the student library.
remaining_unvalidated_methods: Image-based reconstruction accuracy and improvement on independent scenes
Material visual output, rendered pattern direction and illumination separation
Door swing clearance, complete opening geometry and assembly-wide articulation
Mesh-level intersection, true physical contact, connectivity and load-bearing
Support and coordinate behavior across arbitrary transforms and meshes
applicability_and_side_effects: point_camera changes camera transform and possibly lens; hinge_pose changes parenting and transform. Its authored local leaf geometry and unparented hinge assumptions matter; a point-distance report does not verify a full assembly.

mapped_stone creates a material datablock and does not bind it automatically. Probe explicitly bound it; a shared coordinate object controls its reference frame. No external image resources were used by this material.
support_probe samples lowest vertices and only supplied meshes; no hit is unknown, not absent support. Near-zero is not proof of contact. AABB overlap is only broad-phase triage.
